title: Catalog manifest
description: The only file the app fetches unconditionally. It carries a sha256 per shard so a refresh can download nothing but what actually changed, and verify what it does download.

schemaVersion.description: A catalog declaring a version newer than the app supports is refused, not guessed at.

revision.description: Identifies this publication. Shown in the app's refresh row and stored alongside the cache.

generatedAt.description: When build-index.mjs ran. The app prefers its bundled snapshot over a cache older than it.

sourceCount.description: Total across every shard. Displayed before anything is downloaded.

path.description: Repository-relative, appended to the app's base URL.

sha256.description: Over the exact committed bytes. .gitattributes pins these files to LF so a Windows checkout hashes identically.

id.description: Matches the 'shard' field inside the file. Splitting a region into europe-1 and europe-2 is a data change with no app change.
